verdict.rationale: Wrike documents a REST API reference and publishes an llms.txt documentation index, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. An llms.txt docs index and a human-readable reference are adjacent material, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
